I asked the CFO to raise the limit to 45.00 EUR (request P-0001, waiting for Face ID). I'll buy packwise-pro on the card once it is approved. The stock-check buy policy stays on Ridgeline Data at max 0.02, no cache.

Ran dispute settlement for D-f2d71f9a. Nothing refunded. Orders #11–#16 were signed by Summit's own agent, within its mandate, and paid from Summit's account, and the stock data matched the supplier's correction. That contradicts the claim that the orders were unauthorised. All six went to the CFO as proposal P-0002.

Planned the Stockline licence invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 240.00, due 15 Nov) as P-0003. Only the EUR 160.00 shortfall is converted, and it waits for the CFO's Face ID. I made no rebalance because no agent is blocked, and no sweep because the 1.33 net is too small to matter now.

I did nothing this wake. The only new event is Alpenweg's short payment on NW-R-201: they paid EUR 1230.00 against EUR 1240.00. Code has already asked the customer about the EUR 10.00 gap and put the payment in suspense for the CFO, so there's nothing for me to do there. Three items are still waiting for the CFO: P-0001 (policy change), P-0002 (refund batch) and P-0003 (the licence invoice I planned). No agent is blocked by its mandate, so I'm not proposing a rebalance. I'm also leaving the 1.33 net earnings on the business account for now because the amount is too small to sweep.
